mentions.name: Deep-simulation civilization clone
mentions.description: This game is a civilization clone inspired by Dwarf Fortress that simulates the world in unusual depth. Development is currently focused on a geophysics simulation enabling realistic terrain generation driven by mantle convection and plate tectonics, to be followed by a per-cell atmospheric and oceanic model before work on the actual gameplay begins.
mentions.source_excerpt: A civilization clone, but going way deeper than is reasonable (inspired by dwarf fortress). I'm currently building the geophysics simulation that will allow for realistic terrain generation, powered by actual mantle convection and plate tectonics.
